name: AS-EPA weekly Beach Advisory (PDF linked from the Water Quality page)
waters_covered: 40 Tutuila beaches, Aunu'u wharf, 5 Manu'a beaches
access_detail: Wix site. Direct curl gets HTTP 429 'Checking your request' (bot check); WebFetch read the page. The PDF at https://www.asepa.gov/_files/ugd/7916d7_849e39438b8d4067ad4b8169a1f50c64.pdf redirects to filesusr.com and is text (pdftotext works). New PDFs get new opaque ids, so polling means re-reading the page. Sample research/as/raw/beach-advisory-2026-06-17.txt.

sample_record.advice: This advisory is in effect until further sampling and laboratory analyses indicate that Enterococci concentrations are within acceptable water quality standards.

cadence: weekly (Tutuila), monthly (Aunu'u, Manu'a); the linked PDF was 4.5 months old when checked
legal_basis: American Samoa Water Quality Standards; BEACH Act grant
status_reason: The only dated public signal: a bilingual PDF naming the beaches over the enterococci standard, issued weekly for Tutuila (Wednesdays) and monthly for Aunu'u and Manu'a. The page links only the latest PDF, and the one linked on 2026-11-04 was dated 2026-06-17.
notes: The page also says the public should not 'swim, wade, or fish within 400 feet of polluted beaches' and mentions a status map (not located).

name: EPA ECHO SOBE, American Samoa
status_reason: ASPA's Utulei and Tafuna collection systems are registered but no events have been filed.
